correctness.rationale: The integral quartic discriminant reduces to Q²; the Segre map is finite, birational and has smooth source; on a=1 the explicit rank-two algebra R=A⊕bAλ inside B=A⊕Aλ computes conductor (b,d) exactly; symmetric-square restricted conductor is étale away from c=0 and restricts to Frobenius on its diagonal; the generic repeated root adjoins a nonsquare square root of d/b, hence has inseparable degree two. Rational-point formula follows from the bijective normalization off P and scissor counting. The standalone symbolic verifier checks exact polynomial identities and exhaustive counts for q=2,4,8; finite checks are corroboration only.

Historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The natural universal degree-four discriminant has a characteristic-two multiplicity-two equation; computing its exact conductor and contrasting a generically separable double-locus quotient with a generically purely inseparable repeated-root incidence resolves a meaningful wild-characteristic geometry question. The contribution is structural and explains moduli boundary behavior rather than adding arbitrary parameters or merely recording a polynomial formula.
